'''Tobyl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]]. He served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] along with his partner, [[Jat'ho]]. In [[41 ABY]], they were part of a [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Skirmish on Coruscant (Second Galactic Civil War)|operation]] to capture GAG [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|No report? Sergeant Qade will have our heads.|Officer Tobyl, to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
Tobyl was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Invincible" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> Tobyl and his partner, [[Jat'ho]], were part of an [[Skirmish on Coruscant (Second Galactic Civil War)|operation]] to capture [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. After the fight, the two [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were conducting crowd control and guarding a [[Medical speeder|medwagon]] with two wounded GAG [[Agent/Legends|agents]] when they were approached by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Needing the medwagon to pursue the GAG [[doomsled]] carrying Skywalker, Jaina told Tobyl and his partner that she was investigating their [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Qade]], and needed the medwagon to pursue her investigation. She also insisted that no report be written, although Tobyl was at first hesitant. Solo utilized a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince the two officers of her story. Believing her, Tobyl and Jat'ho let her pass, and she took the medwagon. The two officers, meanwhile, returned to their crowd control duties.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A note of commendation will be placed in your file.''"<br />"''Thanks. After my last review, I could use&mdash;''"<br />"''Not ''those'' files, ''ours.''"<br />''"''GAG has a file on me?''"<br />"''Come now, Officer, you ''know'' I can't tell you that.|Jaina Solo, pretending to be GAG, talking to Officer Tobyl|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
Tobyl was handsome, with bright [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and sported a two-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] growth of [[Hair/Legends|beard]] stubble at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the operation to capture Ben Skywalker and Captain Lon Shevu. He was younger than his partner, Jat'ho, yet reacted with more cynicism than Jat'ho toward supposed subversive activities of the Galactic Alliance Guard. When using mind tricks on Tobyl, Jaina Solo noticed that he was weak-minded, allowing her to convince him that she was GAG and allowing her to take the medwagon. In his performance ratings, Tobyl had not received the best of reviews, and the promise of a note of commendation from Jaina Solo encouraged him.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tobyl first appeared in [[Legacy of the Force: Invincible|''Invincible'']], a novel written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="Invincible" /> and published on [[May 13]], [[2008]]<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news20080428.html|text=Del Rey Offers Free Download of First Book in Legacy of the Force Series}}</ref> as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Invincible" /> The entry for Tobyl in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|251|Tobyl}}</ref> which was published on [[December 9]] of the same year,<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> incorrectly lists Tobyl as a member of the Galactic Alliance Guard instead of the Coruscant Security Force.<ref name="CSWE" />
